lines.en: I shift along slowly, heavy with my burden.
Four zombies trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，都像要裂开。
lines.en: Each step feels like I might split open.

lines.zh: 脚陷进泥里，我拔出来再走。
lines.en: My foot sinks in mud; I pull it out and go on.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上鼓出一块。
lines.en: My shadow bulges against the wall.

lines.zh: 我走动时，肚子里有东西动。
lines.en: As I walk, something moves inside me.

lines.zh: 绕着村子走，我挑最窄的路。
lines.en: I circle the village, taking the narrowest paths.

lines.zh: 我喘着，气从喉咙里挤出来。
lines.en: I pant, air squeezing from my throat.

lines.zh: 身后的四人踩着我的脚印。
lines.en: The four behind me step in my footprints.
I stop, and my belly sinks.
I brace on the wall and creep forward.
Two steps, then I need a rest.
I shove aside what blocks my way.
Wet soil sticks to my legs; I don't care.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，往有人在的地方去。
lines.en: I drag my feet toward where the living are.
My joints click, dense and quick.
I stand, heaving up and down.
I press my belly to keep it still.
Four zombies wait beside me.

lines.zh: 我把它们派到各个方向。
lines.en: I send them off in every direction.
There's a sourness in my mouth.
I look down at the ground.
It moves. It keeps moving.
I don't sleep; if I did, it would come out.

lines.zh: 我数着身边还剩下几个。
lines.en: I count how many remain beside me.
Footsteps far off; I tilt an ear.
My nails dig into my palm.
In a moment I'll be hungry again.
Listen. Something stirs in my belly.

lines.zh: 我身后的那些，都是我的。
lines.en: Those behind me are all mine.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，它闻到你了。
lines.en: You're too near. It has smelled you.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，它也在看。
lines.en: While I look at you, it looks too.

lines.zh: 我想让它们出来见见你。
lines.en: I'd like them to come out and meet you.
Your heart races. It grates on me.
I'm slow, but they're fast.

lines.zh: 你不该让我看见你的脸。
lines.en: You shouldn't have let me see your face.

lines.zh: 我肚子里这个，比我还急。
lines.en: The thing inside is more impatient than I am.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能打我吗？
lines.en: Can that thing in your hand hurt me?
I double over, guarding my belly.
That struck my waist.
I step back, panting louder.
The thing inside won't settle.
I bite my lip and stay silent.
A dark patch seeps through my clothes.
Holding my waist, I straighten up.
They crowd around to shield me.
I arch my back and bear it.
You didn't hit just one.
Food? I can't keep anything down.
I'm hungry, but not for that.

lines.zh: 你举起来，我的胃翻了一下。
lines.en: You raise it and my stomach turns.
Put it away. I'm going to vomit.

lines.zh: 我吃的东西，不是这么吃的。
lines.en: What I eat isn't eaten like that.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不够我们几个分。
lines.en: That isn't enough for the lot of us.
I smell it. Very faint.
Set it down first and let me look.
I won't eat it. They will.
Don't try to coax me with that.

lines.zh: 你撞我，先撞到的是肚子。
lines.en: You knock me, and it's my belly you hit.
I stagger back, holding my waist.
Don't touch me there. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我身上那些东西，护着我。
lines.en: My brood shields me.
Stand off; I don't want to crush it.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我喘不上气。
lines.en: That knocked the breath out of me.
I shuffle aside rather than crowd you.
My clothes caught on you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; I grunt.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，肚子里动得更凶。
lines.en: After the bump, it stirs harder.
Another one is carrying too.
We trade a zombie between us.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，肚子贴着肚子。
lines.en: We lean close, belly against belly.
Our kind don't need to negotiate.

lines.zh: 它把最壮的一只让给我。
lines.en: It gives me the strongest one.

lines.zh: 它在我的肩上留了个印。
lines.en: It leaves a mark on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起坐下，各守一边。
lines.en: We sit together, each guarding a side.

lines.zh: 它看了看我的肚子，没说话。
lines.en: It looks at my belly and says nothing.
As night ends, we part ways.
Whatever we carry, we raise alone.
Bending is hard; I take my time.
What's on the ground, I take.
I push it up my sleeve.
A pearl. Good. Kept.

lines.zh: 我捡的时候还得护着肚子。
lines.en: I pick it up while guarding my belly.
Whatever falls belongs to us.
I toss it back to the ones behind.
This iron is heavy; I carry it anyway.
I bend, pick it up, and sniff.
Done, I straighten up slowly.
I smell the blood on you.

lines.zh: 它们已经往你那边去了。
lines.en: They're already on their way to you.
First I call a few out.
Hold still and let me see you.
I'll close you in the middle.
I raise a hand and they move.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让它兴奋。
lines.en: Your scent excites it.
From both sides — you can't block that.

lines.zh: 我要看看你撑不撑得住。
lines.en: Let's see if you can hold.
This time I won't strike myself.
Your leg's caught, isn't it?
I tell them to take their time.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，它们都跟着。
lines.en: Wherever you run, they follow.
I stand back and see it all.
Its hand is on your shoulder.
I count how many blows you have left.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，它们就换方向。
lines.en: I cough once, and they change course.
You're in the corner. That's good.
I raise a hand slowly, pointing at you.
I can hear you panting.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的东西，暴露了你。
lines.en: What you broke gave you away.
Hold on a little longer; I'm coming.
They don't tire; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 你的影子被四个影子围着。
lines.en: Four shadows surround yours.
I spit a mouthful of green.
There is poison under my nails.
I ram with my body and you fly.
My belly hits harder than a fist.
My five fingers clamp your wrist.
They've got you from behind.

lines.zh: 我指甲划开你的喉咙边。
lines.en: My nails rake beside your throat.
Scream. I don't mind.
My strike is slow, but it lands.
That should put you on your knees.
I push myself up out of the wet earth.

lines.zh: 它们跟着我一起站起来。
lines.en: They rise with me.
First I set a hand on my belly.
The smell here isn't bad.
Four shadows settle around me.
I open my eyes; the world sways.
I steady myself on the mud.
Night isn't over. Good.

lines.zh: 我从坑里爬出来，很费劲。
lines.en: Climbing out of the pit takes effort.
They scatter first to scout for me.

lines.zh: 火一沾上来，我身上的皮就裂。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my skin splits.

lines.zh: 我落地时，肚子里重重一沉。
lines.en: On landing, a heavy lurch runs through my belly.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的喉咙堵住了。
lines.en: Water pours in and my throat clogs.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，我护着肚子。
lines.en: The blast flips me; I curl around my belly.
An arrow sinks deep into my shoulder.
A shaft of light pierces into me.
Hunger makes my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我肚子里猛地一蹬。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and the thing inside kicks hard.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，肚子里的也在掉。
lines.en: I fall, and so does what I carry.
